title: Task message
description: Body of every message published to umir.tasks. It is an alarm, not the work itself: the job (recipient, text, payload) stays in the owner's database and is read by jobID. The object is closed, so addresses, phone numbers, one-time codes, tokens and message texts cannot be added.

messageID.description: Opaque string, at most 256 characters, unique within the owner.

jobID.description: Identifier of the job row in the owner's database.

channel.description: Delivery channel. Absent for Auth mail jobs.

generation.description: Storage generation of the owner at the time the job was created.
